cases.name: Hayley Petit
cases.about: She had just graduated from Miss Porter's School, where she played varsity cross country, basketball, and crew and was a high honor roll student. While at Miss Porter's, she was elected to the senior leadership position of Athletic Association Head. She also won a school award for "exceptional community service". Hayley was scheduled to attend Dartmouth College where she wanted to study medicine. Hayley had been an active fundraiser for multiple sclerosis research, following her mother's diagnosis with that disease. She captained a Walk MS Team called Hayley's Hope.

cases.name: Jennifer Hawke-Petit
cases.about: She was a nurse and co-director of the health center at Cheshire Academy, a private boarding school in Cheshire, CT.
cases.narrative: Steven Hayes raped her on her living room floor and strangled her to death. Komisarjevsky doused her lifeless body and parts of the house, including the daughters' bedrooms and daughters themselves, with gasoline.

cases.name: Michaela Petit
cases.about: Michaela, attended the Chase Collegiate School. After Hayley left for college, Michaela planned on taking over Hayley's Hope and renaming it "Michaela's Miracle". Michaela often cooked for her family.
